text: This report seeks the approval of the Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority to award a contract for the implementation of new inbuilding distributed antenna system (DAS) cell phone repeater systems at the following four (4) car parks: Car Park 262: 10 Soho Street Car Park 150: 40 Larch Street Car Park 215: 74 Yorkville Avenue Car Park 286: 51 Dockside Drive As part of Toronto Parking Authority’s journey to delivering best in class customer experience that delivers on choice, ease and speed, Management is investing in the systems needed to provide enhanced cellular coverage within underground garages, which can be suboptimal resulting in connectivity issues for customers, parking IT equipment and staff. The four (4) car parks identified for enhanced cellular coverage were prioritized based on transactional volume, revenues and customer feedback. The new systems will amplify…

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to negotiate, execute and enter into a contract with Linkwave Wireless Solutions Inc., to deliver the Distributed Antenna System Cell Phone Repeater Project (RFP-IT-202405-01), in an amount not exceeding $1,409,904 inclusive of contingency but excluding HST.
